fee_notes: Royalty Fee is 6% of monthly Gross Revenue, deducted from Customer Fees collected by franchisor. Infrastructure Support Payment is an additional 6% of monthly Gross Revenue. Marketing Fund Fee is 2% of monthly Gross Revenue. Cooperative Advertising Programs require contribution of the greater of the required local marketing spend or Co-op-determined amount, not to exceed 2% of monthly Gross Revenue. Local advertising spend is 0%-2% of monthly Gross Revenue (in addition to Marketing Fund Fee). Referral Commissions (Cross Marketing Fees) are currently 5% of amounts earned during initial contract term. Broker Fees vary. If a Substantial Breach occurs, fees may increase by an additional 2% of Gross Revenues. In 2024, the royalty fee was not uniformly imposed.
